[package]
name = "boq"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[lints.clippy]
too_many_arguments = "allow"
result_large_err = "allow"

[dependencies]
amq-protocol-types = "10.6.3"
amq-protocol-uri = "10.6.3"
anyhow = "1.0.72"
axum = { version = "0.8.9" }
axum-extra = { version = "0.12.6", features = ["typed-header"] }
clap = { version = "4.3.19", features = ["derive"] }
configparser = "3.0.2"
console-subscriber = "0.5.0"
constant_time_eq = "0.6.0"
deadpool-postgres = "0.14.0"
django-signing = { git = "https://github.com/mateuszmandera/django-signing-rust", rev = "39804756da0b2aab0a5fc5d4a450df8def5d6c70" }
futures-lite = "2.0.1"
gravatar-rs = "0.2.2"
hex = "0.4.3"
hmac = "0.13"
http-body-util = "0.1.0"
hyper = "1.0.1"
hyper-util = { version = "0.1.1", features = ["http1", "tokio"] }
lapin = { version = "4.11.0", default-features = false, features = ["tokio"] }
serde = { version = "1.0.178", features = ["derive", "rc"] }
serde_json = "1.0.105"
serde_repr = "0.1.16"
serde_with = { version = "3.1.0", features = ["json"] }
sha1 = "0.10.5"
sha2 = "0.11"
slab = "0.4.9"
tokio = { version = "1.29.1", features = [
  "macros",
  "rt-multi-thread",
  "signal",
  "tracing"
] }
tokio-postgres = "0.7.9"
tower-service = "0.3.2"
tracing = "0.1.37"
url = "2.4.1"
uuid = { version = "1.4.1", features = ["fast-rng", "v4", "serde"] }

[build]
rustflags = ["--cfg", "tokio_unstable"]
